tax.text: As a state senator, she sponsored a hospital revenue levy intended to generate new Medicaid funding.
tax.quote: Senate Bill 13 would add Delaware to the list of states with a hospital assessment by phasing in a new 3.58 percent levy on the net patient revenues of Delaware’s acute-care and behavioral health hospitals. In total, the levy is expected to generate more than $100 million in new Medicaid funding between both the assessment and federal matching funds.

wages.text: She called for raising the federal minimum wage to $15 and indexing it to inflation.
wages.quote: Congress must increase the federal minimum wage to $15 and set it to rise with inflation.

debt.text: Her campaign said she is committed to protecting and expanding Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: commitment to protect and expand Social Security and Medicare in Congress.

safety.text: She said she would prioritize reentry and preventing recidivism in criminal justice reform.
safety.quote: I’ll vote to end mass incarceration, legalize marijuana and expunge convictions, and help to reimagine a system that prioritizes reentry and prevents recidivism.

immigration.text: She opposed increased ICE funding and criticized immigration enforcement as a deportation force.
immigration.quote: Congressional Republicans have used funding that should go to your health care for their lawless para-military deportation force.

guns.text: She said she would strengthen background checks and support an assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: When elected to Congress, I will vote to strengthen background checks, ban assault weapons, and institute safeguards to prevent dangerous individuals from getting guns.

abortion.text: She said she supported every pro-choice bill that came before her in the state Senate and would advocate for reproductive freedom in Congress.
abortion.quote: I’ve supported and co-sponsored every pro-choice bill that has come before me and been a champion of bills expanding access to reproductive care in Delaware.

gender.text: As chair of a state Senate committee, she called a bill requiring student athletes to compete according to sex at birth cruel and unnecessary.
gender.quote: Committee chair State Sen. Sarah McBride, a transgender woman, called the bill cruel and unnecessary.

cannabis.text: She said she would vote to legalize marijuana and expunge convictions.
cannabis.quote: I’ll vote to end mass incarceration, legalize marijuana and expunge convictions

health.text: She supports expanding Medicare coverage and lowering its eligibility age, as well as creating a public option.
health.quote: At a minimum, we should expand Medicare to cover dental, vision, and hearing while lowering the age of eligibility and providing a public option.

energy.text: She called for reaching net-zero emissions as soon as possible through domestic action and global investment.
energy.quote: In order to achieve net-zero emissions as soon as possible, the United States must demonstrate commitment to both domestic action and global investment.

voting.text: She said she helped pass vote-by-mail, early-voting, and same-day-registration measures in Delaware.
voting.quote: In the Delaware General Assembly, I have joined many of my colleagues in passing vote by mail, early voting, and same-day voter registration.

immigration.text: He supports ending sanctuary cities and funding immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: I agree with President Trump: end sanctuary cities and enforce the law.

guns.text: He says he would uphold the Second Amendment without exception.
guns.quote: I will uphold the Second Amendment and every other provision, without exception.

abortion.text: He said human life should receive legal protection from conception through natural death.
abortion.quote: Human life deserves legal protection from conception until natural death.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He strongly agreed that biological males should not participate in women's sports or use women's spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

energy.text: He supports using nuclear reactors and fossil fuels to power data centers.
energy.quote: I am for relying upon (small) nuclear reactors and fossil fuel to power legitimate centers.

voting.text: He calls for in-person Election Day voting, photo identification and paper ballots, with limited exceptions.
voting.quote: Votes should be cast in person on election day, except in extenuating circumstances, such as the voter is ill or deployed overseas. Proper, physical documentation - including photo ID - should be required to vote.
